basic_info.description: The height of San Francisco charm is yours in this perfectly appointed Lower Haight condominium. Top-floor 2-bedroom plus den flat in a 2-unit building. Welcoming entry hall leads to light-filled great room with soaring ceilings. Wall of windows open directly to a big private deck with views of Twin Peaks. Remodeled kitchen with plenty of storage including pantry closet plus wide peninsula. Large primary bedroom with two closets flanking handsome decorative fireplace and big windows looking out over quiet, tree-lined Germania St. Second bedroom plus bonus room that makes a perfect, bright office, nursery or smaller third bedroom. Remodeled modern bath with window, heated floor completes the living space. Softwood floors, dual-paned windows. 1-car tandem parking in garage along with two large, locked storage closets. Full floor attic assigned to this unit for storage or possible expansion. Washer/dryer in garage (not shared).  Center of city perfect location. Tucked away on a residential street you are just minutes from bucolic Duboce Park for a dog walk or grab coffee or a meal on Waller, Haight or stroll to Alamo Square, Castro, Mission, Hayes Valley. Biking and transit paradise - hop on the Wiggle or Muni. Return to your quiet home at the end of the day - perfect San Francisco!
